title: Blood Sugar Basics
content: Blood sugar refers to glucose in the blood. Persistently high blood sugar may require follow-up with a clinician.

chunks.content: Blood sugar refers to glucose in the blood and is commonly reviewed with fasting glucose or HbA1c results.

title: Blood Pressure Basics
content: Blood pressure describes the force of blood against artery walls.

chunks.content: Blood pressure readings are usually written as systolic over diastolic pressure.

title: Fever Home Care
content: Fever care often includes hydration and monitoring for warning signs.

chunks.content: Fever care includes hydration, rest, temperature monitoring, and seeking care for severe or persistent symptoms.
